description: This file defines the CredentialsVisitor interface, which processes credentials related to a connection, specifically providing a method for evaluating X.509 client certificates.

classes.name: CredentialsVisitor
classes.description: A generic interface for processing different types of credentials associated with a connection, allowing implementation of custom credential evaluation logic.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Evaluates X.509 client certificate credentials and returns a result of type T.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Evaluates the provided ClientCertificateCredentials and returns the evaluation result.
